Metadata.title: Relay AI
Metadata.description: Answers first. Humans when it matters. A support chatbot for small web shops.

hero.eyebrow: Support chat for small web shops
hero.title: Answers first. Humans when it matters.
hero.lead: Add your FAQ, paste one line of code on your shop, and visitors get instant answers in your own words. When the bot doesn't know, the chat comes to you.

demo.caption: This is the real chat on our demo shop. Ask it something, or try:
demo.q3: Can I talk to a person?
demo.greeting: Hi! I'm Kroj's assistant. Ask me about delivery, returns, sizes or your order.
demo.failed: The live chat is resting right now. The demo store has it too.

cta.note: No sign-up needed for the demo store or the dashboard tour.

steps.title: How it works
steps.lead: Set it up in an afternoon. Change answers whenever you like.

faq.title: Write your answers once
faq.text: Add the questions your customers ask every day, or paste a whole list. In English, Serbian or both.

embed.title: Paste one line on your shop
embed.text: It works on any site where you can add a script. Only the websites you list can use your bot.

handoff.title: Step in when it matters
handoff.text: When the bot isn't sure, or a visitor asks for a person, the chat lands in your inbox and you reply live.
handoff.question: Do you have size 47?
handoff.reply: I'm not sure, and I'd rather not guess. Shall I get a person?

features.title: Made for a shop run by one person
features.lead: Everything you need to stop answering the same questions, and nothing you have to babysit.

answers.title: Answers in your own words
answers.text: The bot replies with your FAQ text and shows which entry it used. If nothing fits, it says so and offers you instead of making something up.

inbox.title: A live inbox
inbox.text: Handed-off chats arrive in real time. Your reply appears in the visitor's chat, or reaches their email if they left one.

actions.title: Orders and tickets
actions.text: Visitors can check an order or open a ticket right in the chat, always with a confirmation step first.

languages.title: English and Serbian
languages.text: The dashboard, the chat and the answers work in both. The bot replies in the visitor's language.

unknown.title: Learns what's missing
unknown.text: Questions it couldn't answer are collected. Your reply becomes a ready-made FAQ draft.

light.title: Light, isolated, private
light.text: The chat is about 13 KB and lives in its own Shadow DOM, so your site's styles can't break it. The only thing it keeps in the visitor's browser is their own chat token.

pricing.title: Simple plans
pricing.lead: Start free. Upgrade when your shop needs more.
pricing.testMode: Demo — test mode, no real charges

free.for: For trying it on your shop

pricing.conversations: {count, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}} a month

credits.q: Do I need an AI subscription or API key?
credits.a: No. Relay finds the FAQ entry that matches the question by meaning and answers with your text, so there's nothing to pay per message.

unknown.q: What happens when the bot doesn't know?
unknown.a: It says so instead of guessing and offers a person. After two misses in a row it hands the chat to your inbox, and the question is saved so you can add it to your FAQ.

platform.q: Will it work on my shop?
platform.a: If your shop lets you add a script tag to its pages, yes. You decide which websites may use your bot.

data.q: What do you store about my visitors?
data.a: Their messages, and their email only if they choose to leave it. IP addresses are stored only as a salted hash for rate limiting, and you can delete any conversation.

try.q: Can I try it without signing up?
try.a: Yes. Chat with the demo store, or open a sandbox dashboard with sample data. The sandbox is deleted after 7 days.

billing.a: This is a portfolio project. Payments run in Stripe's test mode: upgrading uses a test card and nothing is ever charged.

final.title: Try it on the demo shop, then make it yours.
final.lead: Ask the demo bot a question, look around the dashboard, and add your own FAQ when you're ready.

Footer.note: Portfolio project. Runs on free tiers, with no real charges.

descriptions.create_ticket: Collects a subject, details and an optional email, then creates a ticket and emails you through n8n.

Events.title: Event log
Events.subtitle: Everything your bots sent to n8n: emails to you and your visitors, and action calls. Message contents aren't shown here.

mode.simulated: Simulated mode: n8n isn't connected here, so nothing is emailed. Events are recorded as what would have been sent, and actions are computed in the app.
mode.real: Connected to n8n: events go to your workflows, and n8n reports back whether each email went out.

explain.queued: Waiting to be sent to n8n.
explain.retrying: n8n didn't accept it ({attempts} tries so far). Next try {next}.
explain.delivered: n8n accepted it and hasn't reported the result yet.
explain.simulatedEmail: Simulated: would have been emailed via n8n.
explain.simulatedAction: Simulated: computed in the app instead of n8n.

Events.empty: No events yet. They appear when a chat is handed to you, when you reply to a visitor who left, or when an action runs.
